text:
Rory (Growth): Proposal: run a compact experiment tying launch posts + webinar follow-up nudges. We'll test (A) micro time-window credits (48h) vs (B) persistent credits + template spotlight. Mix in two routing rules (standard nurture vs SDR fast-route) to see interaction. Primary KPI: +20% reg->first_api_call within 7 days.

Talia (Design): For social creative I want two frames: "benchmark thread" (short carousel showing cost/latency wins) and "build-in-30" (one-shot walkthrough). We'll A/B them across LinkedIn/Twitter/X.

Lina (Content): Copy idea: short hook + CTA to RSVP. Post-reg email variants must match the arm: time-window credit copy needs urgency language.

Evan (Analytics): Measurement plan: 7-day window. Events to capture: `webinar_reg`, `email_sent_variant`, `credit_claimed`, `first_api_call`, `demo_cta_click`, `sdr_alerted`. Add `experiment_arm` prop. I'll provide dashboard tile comparing arms and a baseline comparison to last 4 webinars.

Rory (Growth): Variant matrix draft:
- Arm 1 (Control): no credits, baseline prompt templates.
- Arm 2 (48h-time-credit): 80 credits redeemable within 48 hours + quickstart pack.
- Arm 3 (persistent-credit): 80 credits redeemable any time + template spotlight + invite to pro tips thread.
Randomize at RSVP completion.

Talia (Design): For the template spotlight, can we show 3 inline vertical examples (support, search, marketing) in the post-reg landing to increase activation intent?

Lina (Content): Yep. Email subject lines (ultra short):
- Control: "You're in"
- 48h-credit: "48h: 80 credits inside"
- Persistent: "80 credits + templates inside"
Post-reg CTAs: "Claim credits" or "Open prompt pack".

Evan (Analytics): Tracking detail: tag UTMs `utm_campaign=webinar_microcredit_v2` and `utm_experiment={arm}`. SQL pseudocode for the tile:
```
SELECT experiment_arm, count(distinct user_id) as regs, sum(case when first_api_call then 1 else 0 end) as activations FROM events WHERE event_time between $start and $end GROUP BY experiment_arm;
```
I'll add cost-per-activation calc assuming credit redemption and expected spend.

Rory (Growth): Routing rules: standard = nurture drip; fast-route = SDR ping if `credit_claimed` OR `demo_cta_click`. If both, tag highest priority. hubspot-bot: add `experiment_arm` and `credit_tier` fields to contact.

hubspot-bot: HubSpot props queued: `experiment_arm`, `credit_tier`, `utm_experiment`. Mapping ETA: EOD Friday.

ops-bot: experiment created: `exp_1933337777_webinar_social_microcredit_v2`  arms: control/48h/persistent; routing: standard/fast-route. Dry-run scheduled Mon 09:15 PT.

Lina (Content): Social captions (short):
- Benchmark thread: "See how teams slash inference cost + ship faster. Join our webinar + try 80 credits."
- Build-in-30: "Build a docs assistant in 30m using our prompt pack + credits."
I'll drop 3 variants per caption in #marketing-assets.

Talia (Design): I'll assemble a 3-card carousel for the benchmark thread and a 1-card step graphic for build-in-30. PNGs to #marketing-assets by Mon 10am.

Evan (Analytics): timeline: tracking signoff by Fri noon, dry-run Mon 09:15, full roll Thurs. Dashboard ready Wed. Post-launch review 10 days after launch.

Rory (Growth): owners: Evan = dashboard & UTMs, Talia = creative, Lina = copy & landing content, hubspot-bot = mapping. Quick sync Fri 11am for signoff.

Lina (Content): one more ask  can we test an extra nudge SMS for a tiny holdout (opt-in only)? If yes, track `sms_nudge_sent`.

Evan (Analytics): add `sms_nudge_sent` to schema if we run it. Keep sample size small to test signal.

Rory (Growth): great. Keep an eye out for duplicates and multi-emails. Flag issues here. :crossed_fingers:
